title: Spherical trigonometry before the modern era:The treatise of Nasir al-Din al-Tusi
summary: This is an overview of Nasir al-Din al-Tusi's Treatise of the quadrilateral, an invaluable 13th century document on spherical geometry which was translated into French in 1891. The title we are using here is the one given by the translator (Alexandre Carath{é}odory). A title which is closer to the original Arabic is ''Disclosing the secrets of the secant figure.'' The term ''secant figure'', to which the title refers, is the so-called ''complete (spherical) quadrilateral'', that is, the figure that underlies what we call today Menelaus' Theorem.
